items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clive Davis. And other people who worked, he recommended them

ctx.x: Clive Davis. And other people who worked, he recommended them, whose names I can’t remember now. But he just went down the line. He was not a selfish guy. He only cared about the music. He started coming to Harlem to my gigs. I was working at Minton’s Playhouse. We were the hottest new act in town. Teddy Hill, who owned – who ran the – Minton’s Playhouse, told me great stories about how he named Dizzy Gillespie. He said they used to come in to rehearse, but Dizzy would always be late, and he was always making…
